entries.question: I want to book an appointment for my dental problems. Is there any way to book the appointment online
entries.answer:
Yes, you can book an appointment for dental services at KGMU online. Here are the methods available:

**1. Online Portal (ORS)**
*   **Website:** [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in)
*   **Process:** Register/Login → Select Uttar Pradesh → Select KGMU → Choose 'New Appointment' → Select the relevant Dental Department → Choose your date and time slot → Pay the ₹50 fee online → Download your appointment slip.

**2. Mobile App**
*   You can use the **ABHA** or **Health Care App** (available on the KGMU Play Store) to follow the same registration and booking process as the ORS portal.

**3. SMS Booking**
*   You can send an SMS with the text **"APPOINTMENT [Patient Name]"** to **8887019134**. You will receive a confirmation for your booking.

**Important Information:**
*   **Fee:** There is a flat fee of ₹50 for the OPD slip, regardless of the booking method used.
*   **On-Site Registration:** If you prefer to walk in, you must bring your Aadhaar card and an active mobile number to receive an OTP for registration at the counter.
*   **Timing:** Please note that OPD registration counters at KGMU close at 1:00 PM (Monday–Friday) and 12:00 PM (Saturday). It is strongly recommended to pre-book your appointment to avoid long wait times.

I am not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline. Also, please avoid sharing personal details (such as Aadhaar numbers or phone numbers) in this chat for your safety.

entries.answer:

न्यूरोलॉजी ओपीडी (Neurology OPD) की जानकारी इस प्रकार है:
*   **स्थान:** ओपीडी भवन (New OPD), तीसरी मंजिल (Third Floor), कमरा नंबर 301, 302।
*   **समय:** ओपीडी का समय सुबह 9:00 बजे से दोपहर 1:00 बजे तक है (सोमवार से शुक्रवार)।

entries.question: opd booking
entries.answer:

*   **Online Portal (ORS):** Visit [www.ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in). Select Uttar Pradesh as the state and KGMU as the hospital to choose your department, date, and time slot.
*   **Mobile App:** Download the **ABHA** or **Health Care** app from the KGMU Play Store and follow the same appointment flow as the ORS portal.
*   **SMS Booking:** Send an SMS with the text "APPOINTMENT [Patient Name]" to **8887019134**.
*   **Walk-in (On-Site):** You can visit the registration counters on campus. You must have the patient's **Aadhaar card** and an **active mobile number** to receive an OTP. 

### **Important Information**
*   **Fee:** There is a flat fee of **₹50** for the OPD slip (applicable to all booking methods).
*   **Timings:**
    *   **Mon–Fri:** 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM
    *   **Sat:** 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM
    *   **Sundays:** Closed
*   **Helpline:** If you need assistance, you can call **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333**.
*   **Outside-city patients:** Please ensure you carry a valid referral letter for your specific department.
*   **Note:** Pre-booking is strongly recommended to avoid long wait times.

entries.question: How can i apply for my mbbs provisional degree certificate
entries.answer:
To apply for your MBBS Provisional Degree Certificate at KGMU, you should follow these steps:

1.  **Visit the Official Website:** Go to [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org).
2.  **Check for Student Services:** Look under the "Students" or "Examination" section for guidelines regarding certificate issuance.
3.  **Application Process:** Generally, you are required to submit a formal application addressed to the **Controller of Examinations, KGMU**.
4.  **Required Documents:** You will typically need to provide:
    *   A copy of your final MBBS mark sheet.
    *   Proof of completion of your internship.
    *   Proof of payment of the prescribed fee (check the current fee structure via the examination portal).
    *   Your registration details.
5.  **Direct Contact:** For specific procedural requirements, current fee amounts, and the application form, please contact the **Examination Office** directly or visit their office located near Gate 1. You can find their contact details in the [KGMU IP Phone Directory](https://kgmu.org/ipphonedirctory.php).

entries.question: Saturday ko kaun sa doctor OPD mein dekhte hain cardiology mein
entries.answer:
KGMU में Cardiology विभाग की OPD (LARI Cardiology) में शनिवार को सामान्यतः वरिष्ठ चिकित्सक और उनकी टीम उपलब्ध रहती है। 

कृपया ध्यान दें:
1. **डॉक्टर की उपलब्धता:** किसी विशिष्ट डॉक्टर के नाम के लिए, आप सीधे Cardiology विभाग की वेबसाइट [https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=9&dept_type=2](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=9&dept_type=2) पर जाकर फैकल्टी लिस्ट देख सकते हैं। 
2. **OPD का समय:** शनिवार को OPD का समय सुबह **9:00 AM से 12:00 PM** तक होता है।
3. **अपॉइंटमेंट:** KGMU में OPD के लिए ऑनलाइन पंजीकरण अनिवार्य है। आप [www.ors.gov.in](http://www.ors.gov.in) पर जाकर अपना अपॉइंटमेंट बुक कर सकते हैं।
4. **संपर्क:** यदि आपको किसी विशेष सहायता की आवश्यकता है, तो आप LARI Cardiology के PRO कार्यालय से **9415099528** पर संपर्क कर सकते हैं।

मैं एक AI सहायक हूँ, यदि आपको कोई स्वास्थ्य समस्या है, तो कृपया KGMU OPD में जाकर डॉक्टर से परामर्श लें। अपनी सुरक्षा के लिए कृपया इस चैट में कोई व्यक्तिगत स्वास्थ्य जानकारी या पहचान पत्र (जैसे आधार नंबर) साझा न करें।

entries.question: Bachelor of radiology
entries.answer:
KGMU mein Bachelor of Radiologic Technology (BRT) ya usse sambandhit courses ke admission ke liye aap niche diye gaye link par jaakar latest admission guidelines aur courses ki jankari dekh sakte hain:

[https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php)

Aap yahan se "Paramedical Courses" section check kar sakte hain, kyunki radiology courses aksar isi category ke antargat aate hain. 

**Kuch mahatvapurn baatein:**
1. KGMU mein admission aam taur par entrance exam (jaise CPET ya university dwara conduct kiya gaya entrance) ke madhyam se hota hai.
2. Eligibility ke liye aapke paas 10+2 (Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Maths) hona zaruri hai.
3. Admission notification aur dates ke liye aapko regular taur par [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) par 'Notice Board' ya 'Admission' section check karte rehna chahiye.

Yadi aapko kisi specific academic year ya entrance exam ke baare mein janna hai, toh please batayein.
